title: EVN Open practice · Level 2: Twenty unseen starts, the Wilson bound
brief: Practice for the EVN Open capstone (G12.4): never a capstone level, which your teacher witnesses on your own option's task. The course fixes one example set of approved requirements. R1 (headline): the whole robot in the green goal. R2 (safety): never touch a wall or a block, and never enter the red crossing. R3: the goal within 20 s. R4: square as the whole robot first fits in the goal (the run ends there, so square up before it): heading within 10 deg of east. A run that breaks R2 scores 0 and fails the level, whatever else it did; any other run scores 25 for each requirement it meets. A requirement is met over the level when it holds on at least 80 % of the runs (R2 on every run). Level 2: twenty runs on starts you did not tune on (+-30 mm, +-4 deg). Pass: no run breaks R2 (one breach fails it), and the lower end of R1's Wilson 95 % interval over the twenty runs is 60 % or more (17 of 20); the card reports every requirement's count. Par: 16 s.

score.run: if(touches > 0 | noGoEntries > 0, 0, 25 + if(reached, 25, 0) + if(reached & time <= tmax, 25, 0) + if(reached & abs(wrap180(endHeading)) <= square, 25, 0))

inTime.value: count(r in runs: r.reached & r.time <= tmax)

squareIn.value: count(r in runs: r.reached & abs(wrap180(r.endHeading)) <= square)

met.value: if(breaches == 0, 1, 0) + if(goal >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0) + if(inTime >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0) + if(squareIn >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0)

wilson.value: let p = goal / n in let z = 1.96 in round(100 * (p + z ^ 2 / (2 * n) - z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z ^ 2 / (4 * n ^ 2))) / (1 + z ^ 2 / n), 1)
